summary: Indian markets trade higher with Sensex gaining 300 points and Nifty surpassing 23,350, led by gains in Realty and FMCG sectors. Dr. Reddy's shares are in focus following a vaccine distribution deal, while Nestle faces regulatory hurdles from FSSAI. Investors remain cautious as the IT sector drags ahead of the upcoming US Federal Reserve decision.
